The project conventions for humans and agents live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Read it first and follow it.

Hard rules (some Copilot surfaces don't load AGENTS.md, so they are repeated here):

- English only for everything in the repo and on GitHub (code, comments, docs, commits, issues, PRs, reviews).
- pnpm only. `npx expo install <pkg>` for any `expo-*` / `react-native-*` package.
- Done means `pnpm check` (typecheck + lint + test) passes. Lint runs with `--max-warnings 0`.
- Never edit, skip or delete a test to make it pass; report the spec/test conflict instead.
- Never add `eslint-disable`, `@ts-ignore` or `any` — fix the underlying problem.
- Never create or edit `ios/` or `android/` (generated by CNG); use `app.config.ts` + config plugins.
- Route files in `src/app/` stay thin; screen UI lives in `src/screens/`. Components never call `fetch`.
- Changing native deps, config plugins, `app.config.ts` or `eas.json` means a store release — say so in the PR.
